name: Neural Volume Super-Resolution
definition: A method that super-resolves volumetric neural scene representations to generate geometrically consistent, high-resolution novel views from low-resolution captures, operating directly on the 3D representation rather than post-rendered 2D images.
summary: Neural Volume Super-Resolution enhances low-resolution 3D scene captures into high-resolution novel views by super-resolving volumetric features directly, ensuring geometric consistency across arbitrary viewing directions unlike 2D post-rendering methods.
